title: 입꼬리 한쪽씩 움직이기
instruction: 한쪽 안면만 가볍게 찡그려 입술을 좌우로 움직이세요.
caption: 입꼬리를 한쪽씩 움직여 보세요.
motion_prompt: Gently pull only one corner of the mouth sideways so the lips shift to one side, hold briefly, release, then demonstrate the opposite side and return to neutral.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: pull the VIEWER-LEFT mouth corner sideways, lips shifted to viewer-left, left cheek retracts subtly; head and gaze remain front-facing
pull the VIEWER-RIGHT mouth corner sideways, lips shifted to viewer-right, right cheek retracts subtly; head and gaze remain front-facing
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for lip_09_one_side_grimace. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Use the attached adult Korean female illustrated therapist as the exact character and style reference. Same face, dark ponytail, white uniform, warm clinic background. Same front-facing head-and-shoulders framing in every tile, mouth and whole jaw clearly visible, same scale and head position, calm gaze. Render each WHOLE face as coherent artwork, including coordinated lip corners, cheeks, jaw, chin and natural linework, texture and shadows. No separately pasted vector mouth. Head/camera stable; jaw moves naturally for lip shapes, remains stable for independent tongue exercises. Tile poses: TILE 1: relaxed neutral closed lips. TILE 2: pull the VIEWER-LEFT mouth corner sideways, lips shifted to viewer-left, left cheek retracts subtly; head and gaze remain front-facing. TILE 3: pull the VIEWER-RIGHT mouth corner sideways, lips shifted to viewer-right, right cheek retracts subtly; head and gaze remain front-facing. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
